SSE_RESPONSE
Description
Triggered when an SSE server response message has been received. iRules may be used to inspect and
optionally adjust certain fields of the message.
Examples
when
SSE_RESPONSE
{
log
local0.
"event is "
[
SSE
::
field
get
event
]
SSE
::
field
set
my-custom-field
my-custom-value
log
local0.
"my-custom-field is "
[
SSE
::
field
get
my-custom-field
]
SSE
::
field
remove
event
}
